description: What changed in a file between the version you have and the newest one (or any two saved versions): how many versions sit between them, the grade before and after, which fixed checks the newer version newly trips or clears (with the text that tripped each one), lines added and removed, and the changed lines themselves. Pass since as a sha256 (or its first 7+ characters, the form mdr.lock records) or a version label. Use it before you update a pinned skill, so the change is read before your agent runs it.

ref.description: owner/repo/name for a skill (anthropics/skills/pdf), owner/repo/path for any other file (vercel/next.js/AGENTS.md), or an art_ id from find_files.

since.description: The version you have: sha256, a sha256 prefix of 7+ characters, or a label like git:20260913.ab12cd3.

to.description: Optional: compare to this version instead of the newest.

name: what_changed
title: What changed since a version
